faq.q: What is a template in this gallery?
faq.a: A ready-made scene with the crop and the setting already chosen. You add your product and get a creator-style photo or video in minutes, without building the shot from nothing.

faq.q: How do I turn a template into a file I can post?
faq.a: Upload your product photo, set the line, and get a finished file. A photo costs 24 credits. A 15-second video costs 60. The cost shows before anything runs.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of hiring a creator?
faq.a: You can launch faster, test a second opening, and change the line without waiting on a creator's calendar.
Shops, marketers, agencies, and anyone who needs a file this week. A one-person shop and a client account use them the same way.

faq.q: Can I make a file if I have never edited video?
faq.a: Yes. A photo of the whole item and one open card are enough. A short ad can use one of 53 AI actors. There is no timeline to learn first.
The cards here show a mug, a tote, a vase, a wallet, a running shoe, and a sunscreen tube. The same idea fits other products. Pick the crop, then compare the file with what you ship.

faq.q: Can I use a photo I took of the product I ship?
faq.a: Yes. The item in the file comes from the photo you upload, or from a product page you paste. See [URL to video](page:url-to-video) when you start from a link.

faq.q: Where can I post the file?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone, 1:1 for a square feed, and 16:9 when the slot is wide. Post it on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube, or download it for the store.

faq.q: Do I pay to make a file from a template?
faq.a: Yes. The pictures here only show the look. A file you make spends credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I run the file as a paid ad and in client work?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, so it can run as a paid ad and sit on your product page. A file you make for a client is the same kind of download.

faq.q: Why not build the ad from a blank page?
faq.a: A blank page makes you invent the room, the crop, and the first line at the same time. The template already chose the scene. You decide the product and the line.
